title: Delta Type
heading: Typing statistics
privacy: Optional trainer; background collection is independent. Full text is not sent. If word frequency is enabled in Type, a word/count dictionary is sent; it can contain private data. Speed excludes pauses above the Type threshold. Enter the field’s BCP-47 language code: browsers cannot report the OS keyboard layout.
statusError: Could not send. Check your node connection and scoped token.
statusEmpty: Enter at least one character first.
statusIME: IME/composition is not supported for accurate counting in this trainer. Use a trusted aggregate client.
statusPaste: Paste is disabled: the trainer measures typing.
statusLanguage: Enter a valid language code, e.g. de-DE, ru or ja.
